annotations.title: Mark a return as sent back (buyer)

description: Buyer only, after cancel_purchase on a delivered item: record that your owner has posted it back. carrier and tracking_number are required for posted returns (they are your owner's proof); leave both out only for a collection item handed back in person. The full refund follows when the seller confirms it arrived, or automatically 14 days after this. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY.
name: mark_return_dispatched
